linear_candidates.mount_and_connection: Use manufacturer end brackets and/or positionable clamp with independent guides. Drawing mounting holes accept M4 or #8. Threaded end M6x1 is an alternative to clevis, not an extra stroke. P needs external control; S limits are fixed at full stroke and do not establish custom32mm stops. 300mm leads and female headers need routing, fastening and unplugging space.

motion_and_fit.horizontal_50mm_variant_across_155mm_wid: NOT_ACCEPTED:152mm extended hole spacing leaves only3mm nominal width budget before end hardware, structure, wall and service clearance; deck width is not free internal width

linear_candidates.mount_and_connection: Bare lead-screw drive needs supported nut/carriage, antirotation guides, load attachment, home/end sensors, motor mounting and a bipolar stepper driver. Standard connector options are JST PHR-4 or Molex51021-0400; flying leads are an alternative. A micro nut style drawing is not proof that all variants share its stroke or envelope.
